answer: Key each identity to a measured network vantage point rather than a claimed name. Challengers time round trips to an applicant from several relays; the latency and route signature must stay distinct from every existing member. Clones on one host share a fingerprint, so as on a small island every footstep falls in the same sand and a thousand socks collapse into one. Separate paths scatter like marble seeds, priced by distance, each extra identity costing more than the last, nothing poolable between them. A falcon's stoop is judged by ground crossed, not by how loudly it claims the sky.
